_howto: Time & Attendance how-to guides. mode click = the user clicks the real button. optional = skipped when not on screen.

guides.title: Create a shift
guides.blurb: Times, breaks, grace periods, overtime and allowances for a shift.

steps.title: Shift Rules
steps.text: Click Shift Rules.

steps.title: Create Shift
steps.text: Click Create Shift.

steps.title: 1. How people clock
steps.text: Pick how this team clocks: Clock in and out, Clock once, Two blocks or Set hours, any time. More types has sessions, record hours only, standby and a paid day. The next steps only ask what matters for the type you pick.

steps.title: 2. Name & colour
steps.text: The name people see on rosters and timesheets, for example Day 07:00-16:00, and its colour.

steps.title: 3. Times
steps.text: When the shift starts and ends. An end before the start is a night shift that ends the next day. The bar shows the day at a glance.

steps.title: 4. Lunch & breaks
steps.text: First in, last out takes a set lunch off the day, or Add up every in and out pays only the time clocked in. Add a lunch window and short-break limits to flag long breaks.

steps.title: 5. Leeway & overtime
steps.text: How many minutes late in or early out still count as on time, and how long before or after the shift extra time becomes overtime.

steps.title: 6. If they don't clock
steps.text: A work day without clockings is marked absent, or completed with 0 hours (e.g. contract workers). You can also pay a minimum number of hours.

steps.title: 7. Overtime setup
steps.text: The company overtime rules are shown for reference. Give this shift its own overtime ruleset, a night shift allowance or an overtime break if it needs one.

steps.title: 8. Check & save
steps.text: Anything that may not work the way you expect, in plain words, with a one-click fix.

steps.title: Create shift
steps.text: Fill in each step on the left, then click Create shift. Give it to people as their default shift in Employee Master, or put it on the roster. Classic form (bottom left) shows every field on one page.

guides.title: Set up a shift with the wizard
guides.blurb: Plain-language steps, a drag-to-edit timeline and test days before you save.

steps.title: Shift Setup Wizard
steps.text: Open the wizard from the sidebar, or with Shift Wizard on Shift Rules.

steps.title: New or existing
steps.text: Pick a shift to change it, or start a new one.

steps.title: How people clock
steps.text: Choose what happens at the clock: in and out, once a day, two blocks, several sessions, set hours any time, record hours only, or a paid day without clocking.

steps.title: Shape it on the timeline
steps.text: Drag the shift and its handles, or answer the questions in each step. Both stay in sync.

steps.title: Test it
steps.text: Use the Try buttons or add your own clockings and check the Paid row and totals.

steps.title: Check the warnings
steps.text: Read the notes before saving: they explain anything that may surprise people on payday.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Save the shift, then assign it on the Weekly Roster or as a department default in System Settings. When you change an existing shift, recalculate the affected days when asked.

guides.title: Build a weekly roster
guides.blurb: Set who works which shift each day, fill a week at once, and save.

steps.title: Weekly Roster
steps.text: Click Weekly Roster.

steps.title: 1. Department
steps.text: Choose the department.

steps.title: 2. Start from the defaults
steps.text: Open Fill roster and pick Auto-fill: it fills the week from each person's default shift and working days. Bulk assign shifts puts one shift on many people, and Create shift pattern repeats rotating shifts for weeks ahead.

steps.title: 3. Adjust
steps.text: Click any day to change that person's shift.

steps.title: 4. Save & Recalculate
steps.text: Appears once you change something: saves the week and recalculates those days.

guides.title: Set your overtime rules
guides.blurb: BCEA limits and rates for everyone, and rulesets for groups that differ.

steps.title: Overtime Rules
steps.text: Click Overtime Rules.

steps.title: 1. Earnings threshold
steps.text: The current BCEA annual earnings threshold.

steps.title: 2. Limits
steps.text: Weekly overtime and daily total hours limits.

steps.title: 3. Weekends
steps.text: Saturday as overtime, Sunday at 2.0x.

steps.title: 4. Rates
steps.text: Overtime, Sunday and public holiday multipliers.

steps.title: 5. Save
steps.text: Change something and an Unsaved changes bar comes up at the bottom of this window: click Save there. The rules apply to everyone without their own ruleset.

steps.title: Groups that differ
steps.text: Add Ruleset for a group with other limits or rates, then give it to their employees or shift.

guides.title: Fix and approve a day on the timeline
guides.blurb: Use the Visual Team View to correct clock times, decide on overtime and approve.

steps.title: Team View
steps.text: Click Team View.

steps.title: Visual
steps.text: Click Visual.

steps.title: 1. The days
steps.text: Choose the day, or a few days, to check. Click a count at the top, such as not approved, to see only those people.

steps.title: 2. Fix a clock time
steps.text: Drag a white handle, or double-click it and type the exact time. The change waits in the yellow bar above until you save.

steps.title: 3. Overtime
steps.text: Click the overtime and choose Approve OT or Decline OT.

steps.title: 4. Save changes
steps.text: Saves everything waiting, recalculates the days, then applies the overtime decisions.

steps.title: 5. Approve
steps.text: Approve one person here, or tick several and use Approve times.
